narr: Enough moisture lingered for thunderstorms to produce flash flooding just south of the Mogollon Rim in Gila County.
ev: Christopher Creek Rose at least a foot. Local roads were flooded and closed.

A flash flood wave on Ellison Creek near the cascades was 2 feet deep and 10-15 feet wider than normal flow was reported at 730 PM. The flood wave (2-3 feet deep) reached the confluence with the East Verde River by 740 PM.
lsr: REPORTED BY KOHLS RANCH FIRE DEPARTMENT: CHRISTOPHER CREEK ROSE A FOOT OF WATER, IF NOT MORE IN SOME LOCATIONS, LOCAL ROADS WERE FLOODING AND BARRICADED, AND LOCALIZED PEA SIZE HAIL.
FLASH FLOOD NEAR ELLISON CREEK CASCADES. 2 FT FLOOD WAVE, MOVED BANKS BACK 10-15 FEET.
FLOOD WAVE 2-3 FT DEEP REACHED ELLISON CREEK CONFLUENCE WITH EAST VERDE RIVER.
